subject: Renewal amendment + sprint credit roadmap
messages:
From: Samantha Choi <samantha.choi@citrinelabs.io>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@citrinelabs.io
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal negotiation + capacity uplift for Q1 go‑live

Hi Mateo,

Hope you’re well — Citrine’s renewal is up mid‑December and we’re planning a phased launch (internal beta in Jan, full go‑live in Mar). We expect token consumption to step up quickly during the first 90 days. Before we finalize the PO our procurement and engineering teams asked if Redwood can:  

- Provide a temporary 90‑day price hold on current rates for any committed capacity we add before Jan 31st.
- Include a one‑time migration/sprint credit to offset onboarding engineering hours (we estimated ~120 engineer hours).
- Add an overage protection cap for the first two quarters to avoid unexpected invoices as usage finds its cadence.

Attached is our internal forecast and a proposed uplift (summary in Citrine_MAPlan_Sept2026.xlsx). Procurement is looped on this message — they’ll need a formal amendment and a redlineable term sheet.

Can you outline what flexibility Redwood can offer here and any conditions (minimum commit, timebound credits, SLA adjustments)? We’re trying to avoid delaying the PO.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if that helps.

— Samantha
Samantha Choi
Head of Platform Engineering | Citrine Labs
Samantha.choi@citrinelabs.io

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Choi <samantha.choi@citrinelabs.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal negotiation + capacity uplift for Q1 go‑live

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear ask and the forecast. Congrats on the launch plans.

Summary of what we can do today (high level):

1) 90‑day price hold: we can offer a 90‑day hold on existing unit pricing for any committed uplift signed by Jan 31, 2027, provided the uplift is a minimum 30% increase over your current committed baseline.

2) Migration / sprint credit: a one‑time credit equal to $75k USD that can be applied to the first invoice after go‑live. This assumes Citrine signs the amendment and the onboarding checklist is completed (two scheduled training sessions + infra runbook handed off).

3) Overage protection: we can cap overage exposure at 1.5x of projected monthly usage for the first two billing quarters post‑go‑live. Any usage beyond that will be billed at the standard overage rate, but we will waive overage invoicing on the first month if usage spikes due to redlineable platform incidents.

I’ve attached a draft term sheet (Citrine_Renewal_Term_Sheet_v3.pdf) with the above language and an appendix that defines the onboarding deliverables. Vanessa (cc’d) will help with the pricing math and Priyom will coordinate the legal/amendment workflow.

If this looks directionally right I’ll turn the term sheet into an amendment for legal review and send to procurement for redlines. If you prefer a quick call, I’m free Tue 11/3 09:00–11:00 PT.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555‑0192

From: Samantha Choi <samantha.choi@citrinelabs.io>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@citrinelabs.io, legal@citrinelabs.io
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal negotiation + capacity uplift for Q1 go‑live

Mateo — this is great, thanks. Procurement has two quick asks before we move to redlines:  

• Can the 30% minimum uplift be expressed as an absolute vCore/GPU equivalent as well as percentage? Our CFO prefers concrete thresholds for internal approvals.
• For the $75k migration credit — can we have a short acceptance checklist (deliverables) that triggers credit issuance? Procurement wants the credit to be tied to completion items not estimated hours.

Legal also flagged rollover language: they want clarity that the 90‑day price hold does not create a precedent for extending the hold beyond that window or for retroactive discounts.

If you can update the amendment to include: an absolute uplift threshold (e.g., +120 reserved GPU‑hours/month), a 3‑item acceptance checklist for the sprint credit, and a clear non‑precedent clause, procurement can turn the PO around quickly. We’ll also need a DocuSign link for the amendment.

Thanks — looping procurement and legal for visibility.

— Samantha

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Choi <samantha.choi@citrinelabs.io>, procurement@citrinelabs.io
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal negotiation + capacity uplift for Q1 go‑live

Thanks — appreciate the clarity. Next steps and mutual action plan: 

1) Amendment updates (action: Mateo) — I updated the draft to:  
   • Express the minimum uplift as both 30% and +120 reserved GPU‑hours/month (section 2.1).
   • Convert the $75k migration credit into a sprint credit with a 3‑item acceptance checklist: (a) handoff of infra runbook, (b) two recorded enablement sessions with Citrine SREs, (c) successful load test at 80% of projected peak. Credit is applied to the first invoice after the acceptance checklist is signed by both parties.
   • Add explicit language that the 90‑day hold is timebound and not a precedent for future discounts or retroactive price changes (section 5.4).

2) Legal / procurement (action: Citrine) — please confirm redlines within 48 hours if possible. Once we have redlines, Priyom will produce a DocuSign envelope and we’ll route to your CFO for signature.

3) Technical onboarding (action: Citrine + Redwood) — Vanessa to coordinate a kickoff and the two enablement sessions. Proposed dates: 2026‑12‑08 and 2026‑12‑15.

4) Billing & overage protection (action: Mateo + Citrine procurement) — overage cap language retained; we included an initial waiver for a single month if usage spikes due to platform incidents. Please confirm acceptance.

I’m attaching the updated term sheet here (Citrine_Renewal_Term_Sheet_v3.pdf — latest edits highlighted). Once procurement confirms, I’ll generate the DocuSign and the HubSpot deal will be moved to Contract Sent: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/CL-2026-092

If procurement would like a short 15‑minute sync now to walk the amendment we can run that today. Otherwise I’ll wait for redlines and produce the DocuSign envelope.

Best regards,
Mateo
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555‑0192
